steps.content: The tip of the pyramid cracks opens into a narrow door. The intruder walks in while a gigantic figure blocks your way.
Hecate, along with her "nightmare", stands in front of you.

steps.speaker: Intruder
steps.content: I will come back to you once I finish what I need to do. Until then, I'll let my <color=#fb9259>pet</color> keep you entertained.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: She's buying time again... But watch out, this enemy is different from the ones we faced!

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: This monster is on a higher level. Chief, be on your guard.
